## v2.2.1

### Changed
- **Reverted the v2.2.0 bottom taskbar in favour of the native openbox way.** The tint2 taskbar did not fit the KDE/Breeze look, so it is gone. Window switching now uses openbox's native, on-demand gestures: **Alt+Tab** (Alt+Shift+Tab backwards) and a **middle-click on the empty desktop** for the full window list (minimised windows included). Krusader stays maximised so the main window does not slip behind on its own.

### Fixed
- **The real cause of "a window disappears" (issue #26).** Krusader's "Show and close to tray" is now forced off (`krusaderrc [Look&Feel] Minimize To Tray=false`) on every start. The minimal openbox desktop has no system tray, so a tray-hidden window could never be recovered; with the option off, minimising always keeps the window reachable via Alt+Tab or the desktop menu.
